params.body:
The share table on "Omzet en aankoop" was always sorted on the last full year. Comparing who led in an earlier year, or overall, meant reading down the whole column.

- **Sortable headers.** Every header (name, each year, "Samen") is now a button that sorts on that column. A second click reverses the order.
- **Default order.** Years and "Samen" sort largest first; the name sorts A to Z. With no choice, the table sorts on the last full year as before.
- **Showing the sort.** The sorted column carries an arrow and `aria-sort`, and its figures are in the darker ink. The note below says what the table is sorted on.
- The choice is kept in the URL (`op=2024`); the direction is not.

Tests: `test_the_share_table_sorts_on_a_clicked_column` covers name up and down, and a year down and up. Full suite green, pint clean, checked in headless Chromium.
